questions.question: What is the primary function of ServiceNow Event Management?

options.text: To create and manage service catalogs
To collect events from various sources and convert them into alerts for tracking and remediation
To manage software licenses across the organization
To perform network discovery and populate the CMDB

explanation.correct: Event Management collects events from different sources, analyzes them, and converts them into alerts. These alerts are then grouped, prioritized, and acted upon to resolve issues and maintain system health. Reference: https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/xanadu-it-operations-management/page/product/event-management/concept/c_EM.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Service Catalog is a separate application for managing request items and services
Software Asset Management handles license tracking
Discovery is a separate ITOM application for finding and mapping infrastructure

source.excerpt: Event Management is a robust application that helps keep your IT systems healthy by spotting problems quickly and fixing them. It collects events from different sources, figures out what's causing the issues, and converts them into alerts.

questions.question: Event Management integrates with external monitoring tools using which two methods? (Choose two.)

options.text: Connectors
Service Catalog items
Listeners
Knowledge articles

explanation.correct: Event Management seamlessly integrates with various monitoring tools via connectors and listeners, enabling comprehensive data collection and correlation. Connectors pull events while listeners receive pushed events. Reference: https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/xanadu-it-operations-management/page/product/event-management/concept/c_EM.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Service Catalog items are for requesting services, not event integration
Knowledge articles store information, not used for event integration

source.excerpt: Event Management seamlessly integrates with various monitoring tools via connectors and listeners, enabling comprehensive data collection and correlation.

questions.question: Which statement best describes the licensing model for Event Management in ServiceNow?

options.text: Included with every ServiceNow platform license at no additional cost
Available as a separate subscription from the main ServiceNow platform
Only available as part of the Enterprise Security package
Requires purchase of all ITOM products together as a bundle

explanation.correct: Event Management is available as a separate subscription from the main ServiceNow platform, allowing organizations to tailor their usage to specific needs. Reference: https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/xanadu-it-operations-management/page/product/event-management/concept/c_EM.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Event Management requires a separate subscription, not included by default
Event Management is part of ITOM, not Enterprise Security
ITOM products can be purchased individually or in combinations

source.excerpt: Available as a separate subscription from the main ServiceNow platform, Event Management allows organizations to tailor their usage to specific needs.

questions.question: Which is NOT a primary capability of ServiceNow Event Management?

options.text: Collecting events from monitoring tools
Converting events into actionable alerts
Managing software license compliance
Grouping and prioritizing alerts for remediation

explanation.correct: Managing software license compliance is the function of Software Asset Management (SAM), not Event Management. Event Management focuses on collecting events, converting them to alerts, and enabling remediation. Reference: https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/xanadu-it-operations-management/page/product/event-management/concept/c_EM.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Event collection is a core Event Management capability
Alert generation from events is the primary function
Alert grouping and prioritization are key features

source.excerpt: Event Management collects events from different sources, figures out what's causing the issues, and converts them into alerts. These alerts are then analyzed, grouped, and acted upon to resolve issues.

questions.question: Which three roles are installed with Event Management?

options.text: evt_mgmt_admin, evt_mgmt_operator, evt_mgmt_user
evt_mgmt_admin, evt_mgmt_operator, evt_mgmt_developer
itom_admin, itom_operator, itom_user
evt_mgmt_admin, evt_mgmt_user, evt_mgmt_viewer

explanation.correct: Event Management installs three primary roles: evt_mgmt_admin (configures properties and rules), evt_mgmt_operator (manages alerts including close and acknowledge), and evt_mgmt_user (read access and basic alert operations). A fourth role, evt_mgmt_integration, is also installed. Reference: https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/xanadu-it-operations-management/page/product/event-management/reference/r_InstalledWithEventManagement.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: There is no evt_mgmt_developer role; the correct roles are admin, operator, and user.
These are not the actual Event Management role names.
There is no evt_mgmt_viewer role; the correct roles include evt_mgmt_operator.

questions.question: What is the relationship between the evt_mgmt_operator and evt_mgmt_user roles?

options.text: They are independent roles with no overlap
evt_mgmt_operator contains the evt_mgmt_user role
evt_mgmt_user contains the evt_mgmt_operator role
Both roles contain the evt_mgmt_admin role

explanation.correct: The evt_mgmt_operator role contains the evt_mgmt_user role. In addition to evt_mgmt_user permissions, the operator can also activate operations on alerts such as acknowledge, close, open incident, and run remediations. Reference: https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/xanadu-it-operations-management/page/product/event-management/reference/r_InstalledWithEventManagement.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: The roles are hierarchical; evt_mgmt_operator includes evt_mgmt_user.
It is the opposite: evt_mgmt_operator contains evt_mgmt_user, not the other way around.
Neither role contains evt_mgmt_admin; admin is a separate higher-level role.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the evt_mgmt_integration role?

options.text: To configure Event Management connectors and listeners
To provide create access to the Event and Registered Nodes tables for integrating with external event sources
To manage the lifecycle of alerts and incidents
To configure and run Service Mapping discoveries

explanation.correct: The evt_mgmt_integration role has create access to the Event [em_event] and Registered Nodes [em_registered_nodes] tables to integrate with external event sources. Reference: https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/xanadu-it-operations-management/page/product/event-management/reference/r_InstalledWithEventManagement.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Configuring connectors and listeners requires the evt_mgmt_admin role.
Managing alert lifecycle is the responsibility of evt_mgmt_operator and evt_mgmt_user roles.
Service Mapping discoveries are not related to the evt_mgmt_integration role.
